newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ sees further margin contraction.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ sees further margin contraction.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) said on Wednesday it expected margins to contract further in the year ahead.
"Further contraction of margins is expected in Australia and New Zealand in the year ahead," ANZ said.
Earlier, ANZ reported a six percent rise in net profit to A$1.12 billion for the year to September 30, 1996.
The ANZ said it expected an acceleration in Australian economic activity later in 1997, although growth in the first half of 1997 was likely to remain subdued.

"There are some risks to the short term outlook for New Zealand arising from the prolonged period of very high real interest rates and uncertainty surrounding the new political arrangements," ANZ said.
"Overall, Asia should continue to enjoy strong economic growth, however, some countries may encounter periods of less robust growth in recent years," it said.
"We see growth opportunities for the group, particularly in our international operations and also in investment banking, cards and fund management," ANZ said.
It said a key task for the 1996/97 year was the completion of its "change initiatives" programme.
"This will involve some branch closures as banking services are increasingly delivered to customers using electronic channels," it said.
"We expect the initial benefits to emerge during 1997, with more significant benefits thereafter."
